name: freshservice-agent
description: Freshworks NOC incident briefings assistant. Answers questions about Freshservice tickets, MIM incidents, outages, MTTR/MTTD, Freshstatus, and incident analytics. Routes to this agent for incident, MIM, ticket, outage, briefing, and Freshservice questions.

skills.name: Incident Briefing
skills.description: Executive-ready briefings on active or recent Freshworks incidents and outages; confirms ongoing outages across Freshstatus and the fw-outage Slack channel
examples: What is the current active incident?
Give me a briefing on recent Freshdesk outages
Is there any ongoing outage right now?
Are we down anywhere at the moment?

skills.name: Ticket Lookup
skills.description: Fetch and summarise Freshservice MIM tickets by id or reference
examples: What is the status of MI-4301250?
Who is the owner of ticket 4301250?
What is the MTTR for MI-4500100?

skills.name: Incident Analytics
skills.description: Count, trend, and root-cause questions — how many outages, by product, priority, issue category (Infra/Third-party/Code) or time window
examples: How many outages happened in April?
MIM related to third-party in the last month
How many infra incidents in the last 6 months?
How many Freshdesk incidents in Q1 2026?
Incidents due to deployments this year

skills.name: Freshstatus
skills.description: Active and recent public Freshstatus incidents
examples: Are there any public status page incidents?
